P. 10</ls>. --II. €3 <ab>P.</ab> (चिकेति) <ab>Ved.</ab> .²1 To observe, see, perceive. .²2 To look steadfastly upon. .²3 To be intent upon. .²4 To seek for, search, investigate, make inquiries, search through. --III. €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> (चयते) .²1 To detest, hate. .²2 To revenge, take vengeance on. --IV. €1 <ab>U.</ab> (चायति-ते) .²1 To fear, dread, be afraid of (with <ab>acc.</ab>) .²2 To respect, honour. .²3 To observe; <ab>cf.</ab> चाय्.
